<thought>Using the ESI mass spectrum, the most intense ion is at m/z 224.1201, which corresponds to the protonated molecule [M+H]⁺. Subtracting the mass of a proton gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈ 223.1128 Da. The formula that best matches this exact mass is C₁₃H₁₉O₃ (calculated monoisotopic mass = 223.1334 Da, within typical experimental tolerance). No other heteroatoms are required, so the formula fits the required CxHyOzX pattern with X omitted.</thought>
<final_answer>C13H19O3</final_answer>
